Parvoviruses are small viruses that can cause a range of diseases in different species, including humans, animals, and plants. D. Only replicate in dividing cells - This is correct. Parvoviruses are able to replicate in dividing cells, which makes them particularly problematic in hosts with rapidly dividing cells.

E. They can infect multiple species - This is not a characteristic of parvoviruses. While they can infect different species, they are not known to infect multiple species simultaneously.

F. They don't require a host to survive - This is incorrect. Parvoviruses require a host to survive and replicate.
